title: Deploys tag the commit they shipped; pnpm release:status says what is due; deploy.sh enforces the deploy-alone rule
acceptance: After every post-deploy check passes (propagation, status smoke, security headers), scripts/deploy.sh creates an annotated tag deploy/<UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHHMMZ>-<sha7> on the deployed commit. Its message holds the commit, the UTC deploy time, the Worker version ID, the rollback version ID and the SPA entry, and the script pushes only that ref. A failed push keeps the local tag, prints the exact push command and exits 3; the deploy stands.

pnpm release:status (scripts/release-status.mjs: local git after git fetch origin main --tags, no Cloudflare call) prints the newest deploy tag (name, commit, time), the origin/main tip and each merged commit since (PR number, title, squash SHA, whether it changes shipped code, its owner-gate classes). It ends with "deploy due" and scripts/deploy.sh <sha> steps in merge order, or "nothing to ship". It says plainly when there is no deploy tag yet and warns when the newest tag is not on origin.

A PR is deploy-alone when one of its shipped files matches scripts/owner-gate.mjs's GATES (imported, not forked). deploy.sh refuses a range from the newest deploy tag to the commit being deployed that mixes a deploy-alone PR with any other shipped change, and prints the steps, unless --allow-batch is passed. With no tag it warns and skips the guard. On the 2026-11-23 range (b9e8141 to 1eed288) the steps split #789 out.

deployment-runbook.md, start-session.md, close-session.md and AGENTS.md describe the tag, the guard, --allow-batch (passed only when the owner says to batch in the session, and recorded in HISTORY) and release:status.

deploy.sh --self-check covers the tag name and message, the tag push and a failed push, the guard refusal, --allow-batch and the no-tag case. scripts/release-status.test.mjs covers the classifier, the step planner and the CLI on a fixture repo, and runs in CI and the AGENTS.md gate as pnpm release-status:test.

evidence.summary: Owner decision, Neo conductor session, recorded on iOS #113: on 2026-11-23 the owner asked for "a dependable marker to trigger deploy and TestFlight updates" and chose "Ask at every close"; on 2026-11-24 the owner answered the conductor's plan with "go". Approved: deploy.sh tags the commit it deployed (Worker version, SPA entry and rollback target in the message), pnpm release:status compares main with the newest tag and says "deploy due" or "nothing to ship", start-session reports it, and close-session asks the owner once when anything is due. Item 2 there, making the deploy-alone rule mechanical, was the conductor's recommendation; the owner approved it on 2026-11-24 (comment 7141036009).

Owner decision, Neo conductor session, 2026-11-24, recorded on iOS #113: the owner said "your \"recommendation on deploying changes alone\" are approved". That approves keeping AGENTS.md's deploy-alone rule and making it mechanical: pnpm release:status splits undeployed PRs into deploy steps with each provider/playback, auth, migration or deploy-infrastructure PR alone, and scripts/deploy.sh refuses a range that mixes such a PR with other shipped changes unless the owner says to batch in the session (--allow-batch, recorded in HISTORY). This PR stays owner-gated, so the owner still approves its merge.

Round 1124 web Lane 1 PR (owner-gated, needs-owner): the deploy tag and its push in scripts/deploy.sh, the deploy-alone guard and --allow-batch, scripts/release-status.mjs (pnpm release:status) and its test, the CI step, and the runbook, start-session, close-session and AGENTS.md text. It also files RF-245 and RF-246. Not merged by the lane; no tag was created or pushed and nothing was deployed.

bash scripts/deploy.sh --self-check passed on the Neo (macOS bash 3.2) with nine new cases: the tag name and message, reading the Worker and rollback versions (unknown when unreadable), the guard warning and skipping with no tag, letting a deploy-alone change ship alone, refusing a deploy-alone batch with the steps, --allow-batch recording the batch, the tag push sending only its own ref to a local bare origin, a failed push keeping the local tag and exiting 3, and a failed tag creation printing the message and exiting 3. Mutations (guard always ok, push --tags, exit 1 instead of 3, tests counted as shipped, no step split) each turned a case red. apps/api/src/lib/deploy-script.test.ts asserts all nine and now has a 60 s timeout.

pnpm release-status:test passed 6 of 6: the shipped-path table, deploy-alone versus the owner-gate classes (agent rules never ship), the four 2026-11-23 PRs (#789 deploy-alone provider / playback, #790 and #792 shipped, #793 not shipped), PR-number parsing, the step planner, and the CLI on a fixture repo with a bare origin (fetch with tags, the report lines and verdicts, guard exit codes, --allow-batch, a redeploy, a rename out of the shipped roots, a local-only tag warning, ignored non-deploy tag names, usage errors). Removing --no-renames, the local-only warning, the tag-name filter or the fetch each turned it red.

Rehearsed in a scratch clone of this repo with local tags only (nothing pushed): with a tag on b9e8141, release:status for the 2026-11-23 range gave two steps, scripts/deploy.sh f87c728 (#789 alone, provider / playback) then scripts/deploy.sh 1eed288 (#790, #792), and --guard 1eed288 refused with exit 1. With a tag on 1eed288, the verdict for ddc811d was "nothing to ship". On the real repo, which has no tags yet, pnpm release:status reported no deploy tag and an unknown verdict.

resolution: Built in #796. scripts/deploy.sh now fetches origin main with tags and runs the deploy-alone guard (node scripts/release-status.mjs --guard) before it builds anything. The guard refuses a range from the newest deploy/* tag that mixes a deploy-alone change with any other shipped change, prints the steps, and lets the deploy through only with --allow-batch. After the propagation loop, status smoke and security headers pass, the script tags the deployed commit deploy/<UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHHMMZ>-<sha7>. The message carries the commit, the UTC time, the Worker version (from WRANGLER_OUTPUT_FILE_PATH), the rollback version (from the pre-deploy wrangler deployments status), the SPA entry, the previous tag and any allowed batch. It pushes only that ref, and exits 3 with the push command if the tag cannot be created or pushed (the deploy stands). pnpm release:status reports the newest tag, the merges since with shipped and owner-gate classes, and "deploy due" with steps or "nothing to ship". Shipped means apps/api, apps/web, packages and five root build inputs, minus tests, Markdown and repo tools. Deploy-alone means a shipped file matched by owner-gate GATES, imported unchanged. The runbook, start-session steps 5 and 9, close-session §5 and AGENTS.md describe it. Post-merge acceptance (backfilling the 1eed288 tag, the first real tagged deploy) is RF-245. The owner-gate coverage gap for scripts/release-status.mjs is RF-246.
